user.title: Add RBX-S73 camera
user.description: Enter the camera's local IP and its 20-character device UID (from the UBox app or the camera label). The view password is discovered automatically. Home Assistant must be on the same LAN as the camera.

data.client_ip: This Home Assistant host's LAN IP (leave blank to auto-detect)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the camera on the LAN (LAN-search got no reply). Check the IP/UID and that HA is on the same subnet.

init.title: Camera, PTZ & time-lapse settings
init.description: Session model controls how the single camera connection is kept (a battery vs. reliability trade-off). Time-lapse captures frames on a schedule when its switch is on.

data.timelapse_compile_hour: Daily auto-compile hour (0-23, or -1 to disable)

options.solar: Solar: permanent by day, keep-warm at night
options.keep_warm: Keep-warm: hold a few minutes after use

compile_timelapse.name: Compile time-lapse
compile_timelapse.description: Compile captured frames into a saved mp4 — a single day or a multi-day range.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day to include (defaults to today).

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day to include (defaults to the start date = single day).

export_timelapse.name: Export time-lapse (range)
export_timelapse.description: Compile the frames captured between two date-times into a temporary mp4 (auto-deleted after a few hours). Browse it under Media.
